02  Any women having
professional degree/

 Psycho-social Counsellor will provide
psychological counselling and guidence
to the women affected by violence and
support in rererral services that mey be
deemed fit for the women affected by
the violence based on her needs. She
will help to cope the trauma and other
strees of sheltered surviouries .
 She will help draft the case history of
the women affacted by the violence.
 She will be responsible for other work
as assigned by the Centre Administrator.
2 Case
Worker
02  Any women having a
Bachelor in Law/ Social
Work/ Sociology/
Social Science/
Psychology with at least
3 Years” Experience of
working on women
related relevant
domains in a
Government or Non-
Government Project/
Programme.
 She should be a
resident of the local
community so that local
human resource and
expertise is utiliset for
effective functioning of
the centre.
 Case worker will work in shifts to
provide 24 hour service at OSC.
 She will provide assistance and support
to the Centre Administrator in
Facilitating services to women
accessing OSC
 She will intervence in cases of VAW
and will take them to their logical
conclusion.
 She will be responsible for other work
as assigned by the Centre Administrator.
